protocol.fit: No learned prior refitting or raw-train feature inputs
protocol.precision: lambda_prior I + observed precision + temporal and compressed undirected spatial Laplacians
protocol.quality: Strict finite observations weight1; extra values weight .25*min(pct/.75,1)^2 with known quality
protocol.robustness: Fixed normalized innovation cutoffs speed .4, lane-flow .2; same cutoffs optionally gate time edges
protocol.solver: Jacobi-preconditioned CG rtol1e-8, max400; verify actual relative residual<=2e-8
protocol.selection: Highest calibration pooled State, ties favor strength0/lower strength; architecture/hyperparameters cal only
protocol.joint_selection: Minimum incomplete target-touching increment L1, cal State >= frozen prior -.001
protocol.assessment: Existing public-train development dates; all choices sealed before reading assessment caches
protocol.causality: Offline State with bidirectional observations; prohibited as future Queue features
